Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
Yes, we do ship internationally to many countries around the world. 🌍
Customs duties or import taxes may apply depending on your country. These are set by your local customs authority and are paid by the person receiving the parcel. We don’t control or cover these charges, and they’re separate from what you pay at checkout.
It’s a good idea to check with your local customs office before ordering, as rules and thresholds vary by country.
